name: Supergirl
summary: Superman's older cousin, who arrived later and brought her own hope. Kara Zor-El survived Krypton's death in Argo City and has the same sun-fuelled powers as Kal-El.
origin: Supergirl is Superman's cousin, technically his elder, and she often gets to be the more hopeful one. Otto Binder and Al Plastino introduced Kara Zor-El in Action Comics #252 in 1959. Her father Zor-El, Jor-El's brother, kept a piece of Krypton alive as Argo City after the planet died, and when that refuge was doomed too, her parents sent her to Earth. Like Kal-El she draws power from the yellow sun: super strength and speed, flight, heat vision, freezing breath, X-ray eyes and super-hearing. She famously died saving the multiverse in Crisis on Infinite Earths in 1985, and modern versions brought her back as a teenager finding her place on a strange planet.

storyline.title: Cousin from Argo
storyline.beat: Kara Zor-El, Superman's cousin, arrives on Earth from Argo City, a surviving piece of Krypton. She hides in an orphanage as Linda Lee while learning to be a hero.

storyline.title: Revealed to the world
storyline.beat: Superman finally introduces Supergirl to the public.

storyline.title: Sacrifice
storyline.beat: In Crisis on Infinite Earths, Kara dies fighting the Anti-Monitor, a moment captured on one of comics' most famous covers.

storyline.title: Kara is back
storyline.beat: Superman/Batman brings Kara Zor-El back into continuity, arriving on Earth years after her cousin.

storyline.title: Supergirl series
storyline.beat: Melissa Benoist stars in the Supergirl TV series for six seasons.

gossip.text: Kara Zor-El was the first Super-Girl.
gossip.truth: A 1958 Superman story tried out a magically created Super-Girl a year before Kara arrived.

gossip.text: Kara is technically older than Superman. She was a teenager when he was a baby, but she reached Earth much later.
The cover of Crisis on Infinite Earths #7, with Superman holding Kara, is one of the most copied in comics.
Helen Slater starred in the 1984 Supergirl film.

quiz.q: How is Supergirl related to Superman?
Which Kryptonian city did Kara come from?
In which event did Kara die in 1985?

theme.tagline: Superman's cousin, older and arguably cooler.

timeline.title: Last daughter of Argo
timeline.note: Action Comics #252 sends Kara Zor-El to Earth, where her cousin Superman hides her in an orphanage.

timeline.title: Going public
timeline.note: Action Comics #285 reveals Supergirl to the world after years as a secret.

timeline.title: Helen Slater flies
timeline.note: Helen Slater stars in the Supergirl feature film, a spinoff of the Christopher Reeve movies.

timeline.title: Crisis sacrifice
timeline.note: Kara dies fighting the Anti-Monitor in Crisis on Infinite Earths #7, and DC wipes her from history.

timeline.title: Kara returns
timeline.note: Superman/Batman #8 brings the Kryptonian Kara back to the DCU, crash-landing in a rocket.

timeline.title: Supergirl on TV
timeline.note: Melissa Benoist stars in the Supergirl TV series, which runs for six seasons.

timeline.title: Woman of Tomorrow
timeline.note: Tom King and Bilquis Evely's Woman of Tomorrow sends Kara on a gritty space trek with a vengeful alien girl.

timeline.title: Supergirl the movie
timeline.note: Milly Alcock headlines DC Studios' Supergirl, loosely adapted from Woman of Tomorrow.
